facts.fact: On 26 June 2025 the Ministry of Employment and Social Protection formally received, under a 13 May 2025 convention with the MTN Foundation, a job-matching website for job-seekers with disabilities, multimedia rooms at the Ivorian School for the Deaf and Felix Houphouet-Boigny University, and a YouTube channel for ECIS pupils.
